_comment: FY2025 grounded actuals (tech/semiconductor). SMIC reports in USD (HK/Shanghai-listed). Source: SMIC FY2025 results, Feb 2026 (smics.com), confirmed by TrendForce / C114 / Futu. Revenue US$9.327bn (+16.2% YoY, record); net profit attributable to listed-company shareholders US$685mn (~RMB 4.95bn, +39% YoY); gross margin 21.0% (+3pp). SMIC skipped the annual dividend to fund capacity expansion (7nm). EPS / operating margin / FCF not cleanly disclosed in USD here. (Note: one widely-cited source mis-stated revenue as $93.27bn — the correct figure is $9.327bn.)
